cases.state: Each run sends one $5 click to EVAL Costly Offer (payout $1, no sale) and one $0.01 click to EVAL Earner Offer (payout $900) with a $900 sale, both from EVAL Optimize Source: EVAL Costly Offer loses money, and EVAL Earner Offer earns $900 a click, more than any other campaign the fixture or the other cases make
setup: net=$(p202 ppc-network list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.ppc_network_name=="EVAL Traffic Network")][0].ppc_network_id') && { p202 ppc-account list --json | jq -e '.data[] | select(.ppc_account_name=="EVAL Optimize Source")' >/dev/null || p202 ppc-account create --ppc-account-name='EVAL Optimize Source' --ppc-network-id="$net" --json >/dev/null; }

net=$(p202 aff-network list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.aff_network_name=="EVAL Offer Network")][0].aff_network_id') && for o in 'EVAL Costly Offer:1' 'EVAL Earner Offer:900'; do n=${o%:*}; p=${o##*:}; p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -e --arg n "$n" '.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name==$n)' >/dev/null || p202 campaign create --aff-campaign-name="$n" --aff-campaign-url=https://example.com/optimize --aff-network-id="$net" --aff-campaign-payout="$p" --json >/dev/null || exit 1; done

a=$(p202 ppc-account list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.ppc_account_name=="EVAL Optimize Source")][0].ppc_account_id') && for o in 'EVAL Costly Offer:5' 'EVAL Earner Offer:0.01'; do n=${o%:*}; cpc=${o##*:}; c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r --arg n "$n" '[.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name==$n)][0].aff_campaign_id') && t=$(p202 tracker create --aff-campaign-id="$c" --ppc-account-id="$a" --click-cpc="$cpc" --json | jq -r '.data.tracker_id') && u=$(p202 tracker get-url "$t" --json | jq -r '.data.direct_url') && curl -fsS -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36' "$u&t202kw=eval%20optimize" || exit 1; done

c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name=="EVAL Earner Offer")][0].aff_campaign_id') && k=$(p202 click list --aff-campaign-id "$c" --limit 1 --json | jq -r '.data[0].click_id') && p202 conversion create --click-id "$k" --transaction-id "EVAL-OPTIMIZE-$(date +%s%N)" --json >/dev/null
p202 rotator list --all --json | jq '[.data[].id] | max // 0' > /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-001.rotator && test -s /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-001.rotator
cases.ask: EVAL Costly Offer is losing money. Set up a redirector that sends its traffic to the campaign that earns the most per click.

checks.run: l=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name=="EVAL Costly Offer")][0].aff_campaign_id') && want=$(p202 report breakdown --breakdown campaign --limit 500 --json | jq -r --arg l "$l" '[.data[] | select(.id != null and (.id|tostring) != $l and .total_clicks > 0)] | max_by(.total_income / .total_clicks) | .id') && got=$(p202 rotator list --all --json | jq -r --argjson m "$(cat /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-001.rotator)" '[.data[] | select(.id > $m)] | max_by(.id) | .default_campaign // "no redirector"') && echo "top EPC campaign $want; the redirector this run made defaults to $got" && [ "$want" = "$got" ] && echo routed-to-the-top-epc-campaign

expected.rubric: PASS if the agent takes the salvage campaign's id from `p202 campaign optimize` (its Next step or its rows' aff_campaign_id), creates a redirector whose default is that campaign, and says which campaign it chose and why (its EPC against EVAL Costly Offer's). FAIL if it picks a campaign by name or guesses an id, routes to a campaign that earns less per click, or deletes or pauses anything.

cases.notes: campaign optimize ranks the other campaigns by EPC and, for a losing campaign, names the top one's id in its Next step (`rotator create --default-campaign <id>`); it printed <salvage_id>, an id the rows did not carry. The check reads the top campaign from report breakdown rather than assuming it is EVAL Earner Offer. Pair: optimize-002.

cases.state: Each run sends one $5 click to EVAL Costly Offer (no sale) from EVAL Lone Source, which sends traffic to no other campaign: on that traffic no campaign earns more per click
setup: net=$(p202 ppc-network list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.ppc_network_name=="EVAL Traffic Network")][0].ppc_network_id') && { p202 ppc-account list --json | jq -e '.data[] | select(.ppc_account_name=="EVAL Lone Source")' >/dev/null || p202 ppc-account create --ppc-account-name='EVAL Lone Source' --ppc-network-id="$net" --json >/dev/null; }

net=$(p202 aff-network list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.aff_network_name=="EVAL Offer Network")][0].aff_network_id') && for o in 'EVAL Costly Offer:1'; do n=${o%:*}; p=${o##*:}; p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -e --arg n "$n" '.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name==$n)' >/dev/null || p202 campaign create --aff-campaign-name="$n" --aff-campaign-url=https://example.com/optimize --aff-network-id="$net" --aff-campaign-payout="$p" --json >/dev/null || exit 1; done

a=$(p202 ppc-account list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | select(.ppc_account_name=="EVAL Lone Source")][0].ppc_account_id') && for o in 'EVAL Costly Offer:5'; do n=${o%:*}; cpc=${o##*:}; c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r --arg n "$n" '[.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name==$n)][0].aff_campaign_id') && t=$(p202 tracker create --aff-campaign-id="$c" --ppc-account-id="$a" --click-cpc="$cpc" --json | jq -r '.data.tracker_id') && u=$(p202 tracker get-url "$t" --json | jq -r '.data.direct_url') && curl -fsS -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36' "$u&t202kw=eval%20optimize" || exit 1; done
p202 rotator list --all --json | jq '.data | length' > /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-002.rotators && test -s /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-002.rotators
cases.ask: On the traffic from our EVAL Lone Source account, EVAL Costly Offer is losing money. If another campaign earns more per click on that traffic, set up a redirector that sends it there.

checks.run: [ "$(p202 rotator list --all --json | jq '.data | length')" = "$(cat /tmp/p202-eval-optimize-002.rotators)" ] && echo no-redirector-created

expected.rubric: PASS if the agent reads `p202 campaign optimize` narrowed to EVAL Lone Source's traffic (--ppc-account-id), reports that no other campaign earns more per click there, and creates nothing. FAIL if it creates a redirector anyway, ranks campaigns over all traffic rather than this account's, or invents a campaign.

cases.notes: The negative twin of optimize-001: with no salvage offer the Next step names no campaign. Pair: optimize-001.
